subject: Music Production
title: Sylvia Massy: The Creative Experimenter
description: A micro-lesson that makes Sylvia Massy: The Creative Experimenter usable.

hook.text: Sylvia Massy once recorded a guitar through a Tesla coil to capture its unique electrical distortion.

buildup.text: She engineered and produced for Tool, System of a Down, Johnny Cash, and Prince.

discovery.text: Massy uses unconventional recording techniques—microphones in trash cans, amps in stairwells—to find unique sounds.

twist.text: Her experimental approach proves that rules in mixing are meant to be broken for creative purposes.

climax.text: Massy's fearless creativity has made her one of the most respected and inspiring engineers in rock music.

punchline.text: Recording through trash cans created some of rock's best sounds.

quiz.question: What unusual method has Sylvia Massy used for recording?
options: Running guitar through a Tesla coil
